Desc_493.cn: 结海楼乃灵气所化，其质捉摸不定，若有云气笼罩于其中，可随佩者心意，化作海市蜃楼，使人如冯虚御风，优游无碍，故取“月下飞天镜，云生结海楼”之意而名之。

Desc_494.en: An exquisite artifact, the Colorless Bracer is transparent and colorless. Although others cannot see it, the wearer is sheltered by a spiritual Qi. There is this saying, "Colors will blind the eyes of ordinary people, so the wise uses their heart and not their eyes to see." Therefore, only Immortals can see through the aura.
Desc_494.cn: 玄元无色臂鬼斧神工，其质空明而无色，旁人虽不可察，佩者却能受灵气庇护，相传“五色令人目盲，是以圣人为腹不为目，故去彼取此”，故而唯有仙人可识其本来面目。

Desc_495.en: Jute Sleeves are made of jute cloth, rough but rustic. They can tighten the cuffs for flexible action and are very popular.
Desc_495.cn: 黄麻束袖乃是以黄麻布制成的束袖，挺括天然，粗犷质朴，可将袖口收紧，清爽便利，百姓多用之。

Desc_496.en: Cotton Sleevelets are made of fine cotton silk that can be dyed into a variety of colors. Worn outside the sleeves, they are wear-resistant, easy to remove and replace, and can provide some protection.
Desc_496.cn: 棉布套袖乃取用细腻的棉丝制成，可染成多种颜色，套在袖外，防脏耐磨，易拆易换，亦有一定的防护效果。

Desc_497.en: Silk with dark patterns is not easy to see at a distance, but it gleams when nearby. The Dark Pattern Wristband is soft and comfortable like ordinary silk, while symbolizing a gentleman's modest virtue, which has been loved by the cultivated rich and noble families.
Desc_497.cn: 绸用暗纹，远观不见，近则生辉。暗纹绸腕质地柔软舒适，既得寻常绸缎之轻薄便体，又有君子内敛之德，素为清贵所爱。

Desc_498.en: In a breeze leaves float, as light as the snow is the silk coat. The fragrant silk is covered with small holes, making it light, soft and breathable, while also faintly emitting a fragrance. It is the best of fabrics, and bracers made of it can nourish the spirit and Qi.
Desc_498.cn: “细葛含风软，香罗叠雪轻”，香罗上有椒孔，轻便透气，质地柔软，暗香浮动，乃布中佳品，以之制成的护腕有养护神气之能。

Desc_499.en: Soaked in the fragrance of flowers, Flying Butterfly Sleeves are originally intended to channel the spirit and Qi, but they attract butterflies that flutter with one's motion instead, as if flowers were blooming on the arms and wrists, transforming the wearer into a fairy-like beauty.
Desc_499.cn: 飞蝶逐花袖浸透百花芳香，本是疏导精气之用，却能引蝴蝶翩翩而至，随袖翻飞，如见鲜花绽于臂腕之上，美丽动人，可令佩者望之如仙子。

Desc_500.en: The Blossom Sound Sleeves are woven with spiritual silk and have an icy touch like snow, but they can make the wearer feel calm, perceive changes in the weather, and hear even the subtlest sounds of flowers blooming. "On distant clouds the moon perches; fragrance of the plum the snow searches."
Desc_500.cn: 倚雪听梅袖乃灵丝织成，质如冰雪，入手极凉，却可使人神安气定，感知天地变化，即令声如花开之微，亦能觉察，故有赞曰：“浮云望月非是远，落雪听梅固宜香”。

Desc_501.en: With an indefinite shape, the sleeve flutters like mountain clouds scattering and gathering with the wind, changing as it wishes, unrestrained and following its nature. No mortal knows where it starts and where it ends, and no one dares to take it lightly.
Desc_501.cn: 所谓“玉树溶溶仙气深，含光混俗似无心”，此袖无有定形，飘忽不定，如同山云随风散聚，如意变化，顺乎自然，奥妙无拘，凡人不知其何从起、何所去，莫敢轻视。

Desc_502.en: There are five elements: gold, wood, water, fire, and earth. The wearer can take advantage of the power of nature, change in response to the times, and follow the way of the five elements for their own advantage.
Desc_502.cn: 天干两两相对，成就五合，又化金、木、水、火、土五行，称为五合化气。此物以五合化气为名，性质亦如其理，佩者可借天地之威，应时而变，循五行生克之道，化用奇气。

Desc_503.en: The Celestial Embroidery is woven without a trace of cuts, as if naturally formed with embroideries for the Immortals, with nine channels of hazy light drifting around, which can protect the soul, nourish the meridians, and make the wearer become immortal. Legend has it that it was originally used by the Lord of the Heavens, but for some reason it ended up on earth.
Desc_503.cn: 天女文绣浑无一丝裁剪痕迹，宛若天人之衣，其上绣样自生，又有九道霞光飘游明灭，着之可护神魂，养经络，使人逸凡脱俗，传说本乃天帝所用，不知何故流落人间。

Desc_504.en: Made of raw agate cut and polished, the Agate Bracer is pitch black, smooth, and soft with naturally formed patterns. It's often worn as an ornament, but also can provide some protection.
Desc_504.cn: 玛瑙护腕乃以玛瑙原石切割打磨而成，其色漆黑，质地温润，玉纹自生，常作装饰，亦有些许防护之能。

Desc_505.en: The Blossom with Leaves is a crystal clear bracelet carved in the shape of green leaves and blooming flowers according to the natural coloring of the jade. "As blossoms grow, prosperities glow."
Desc_505.cn: 花叶镯取叶绿花红、花伴叶生图景，随玉色不同，雕成一镯，晶莹剔透，有“方华蔓长，名此曰昌”之意。

Desc_506.en: The style of two diamonds overlapping each other is a symbol of good fortune passed down from ancient times. Two diamond-shaped jade stones either the same or different colors and patterns are set on the armlet, giving it an elegant and auspicious appearance.
Desc_506.cn: 双菱相扣，便为叠胜。叠胜臂箍寓意吉祥，乃上古所传之式样，两枚菱形玉石颜色、花纹或同或异，箍于臂上，简朴大方，相映成趣。

Desc_507.en: It is said that the cicada sings in high trees and only feeds on dew and wind, making it the purest of all insects. The Jade Cicada Armguard is made of jade in the shape of a ring, on which the shape of a cicada is carved. Although the wearer must feed on grain, unlike the cicada, it still dispels the turbid energy in the body and cultivates the spirit.
Desc_507.cn: 蝉居高声远，餐风饮露，乃草虫中至洁者，玉蝉臂束以美玉制成玦形，阳刻玉蝉于其上，佩之者虽不可不食五谷，亦能和清去浊，导养神气。

Desc_508.en: Pixiu, also known as Pixie (ward off evil), was a symbol of courage in ancient times. Pixiu Vambraces have prismatic colors and lifelike carvings, which can be worn to nourish the righteousness and drive away evil.
Desc_508.cn: “寻邑百万，貔虎为群”，貔貅又名辟邪，古之骁勇多用之。貔貅护臂五色陆离，造体自然，其上兽型栩栩如生，佩之可养正气，使虚邪不扰。

Desc_509.en: The sun and moon shines; following the cycle of the cosmos. the Radiance Armlet is made of the brightest stones, and its radiance shines like the sun and the moon, hence the name. Legend has it that it can make the human mind clear and pure, and in harmony with the heavenly way.
Desc_509.cn: 所谓“日月昭明，列宿有常”，昭明环乃以石中最亮者制成，其上光耀星繁，辉同日月，遍照大千，故而名之，传说亦能使人心澈明无瑕，与天道相依。

Desc_510.en: The Immutable is made of the most solid of stone, "as unchangeable as the redness of cinnabar and the hardness of stone." It emits a shimmering light like the stars. If one wears it, they will be in a trance at first, and then reach the realm of infinity and understand the immutable truth of the unchangeable nature of the cosmos.
Desc_510.cn: 石赤不夺以至坚之石制成，取“石赤不夺，节士之必”之意，其色幽然，莹光流转如星辰，人若佩之，则初时恍惚若失，其后似达无穷之境，通万世不移之理。

Desc_511.en: The Yin Yang Armlets are a pair of twin armlets, which are black and white with Yin and Yang intertwined and reflecting each other as radiantly as daylight, just as Yin and Yang give birth to all things. "Upon the noblest the five divine colors shine and gleam in all four directions."
Desc_511.cn: 阴阳至德环为一对双环，黑白交织，阴阳相照，其上光如日色，所谓“至德所加，布璀璨之五色，被辉光于四遐”，至明至璨，至简至纯，便如阴阳二气生化万物，妙不可言。

Desc_512.en: Enlightened by the Buddhist teachings; as though a thousand lights shone in one mirror. The Lamps in Mirror is a bracelet made of a rare stone. It's smooth as a mirror, in which a thousand bright lamps can be seen. It is said that all wisdom is within it and can be imparted into one's consciousness.
Desc_512.cn: 偈云：“诸佛法身入我性，状似千灯含一镜”。千灯一镜乃以奇石制成的手环，光滑如镜，镜中可见千盏明灯，相传诸智慧法便在其中，可化入人心，使世间精妙，无一不具。

Desc_513.en: Jade Handwraps are made of crystal jade polished into pieces. They are warm and transparent. They can cover the hands, making the wearer's hands look like they are made of jade from a distance.
Desc_513.cn: 玉裹手乃是以打磨成片的晶玉制成，其质温润通透，由指及腕，皆可覆盖，远望则手同玉色，恍然无别。

Desc_514.en: The Arc Arm Ornament is cyan, with a simple and elegant half-arc pattern like waves and the waning moon. "Beneath are waves pure; above is the moonlight clear."
Desc_514.cn: 半弧臂饰颜色青碧，其上半弧纹路如水波、如残月，简约雅致，有“俯视清水波，仰看明月光”之悠扬意境。

Desc_515.en: Made of small pieces of jade, the Icy Crystal Strings is as cold to the touch as if wearing a string of ice around the wrist. It looks charming and delightful and cools one down in warm weather and refreshes the mind.
Desc_515.cn: 冰晶手串乃以美玉琢成，入手冰凉，如粒粒冰晶缀于腕间，玲珑可爱，佩之可消暑热、避浊气，使人耳聪目明。

Desc_516.en: Clouds above glow, imperial might we behold. Colorful clouds have been an auspicious omen since ancient times. The Colorful Clouds Armlet is made of beautiful jade that changes color with the angle of observation, just like clouds drifting around the sun, and the wearer would seem as if riding on them.
Desc_516.cn: “景云霏烂，告我帝符”，景云即彩云，素为吉祥之兆。景云臂珰乃以美玉制成，其上光华瞬息万变，如云蒸霞蔚，佩者亦似乘云而归。

Desc_517.en: A heart as pure as the lotus flower; so mind not the withering power. The Lotus Bracer is carved in the shape of a flower with precious jade, symbolizing that the Buddhist nature of human beings is like the lotus flower, born in the sludge but unstained.
Desc_517.cn: 所谓“但教心似莲花洁，何必身如槁木齐”，莲华约腕以宝玉雕成花形，其上流光溢彩，象征人之佛性如莲华一般，出于污泥而不伤其洁。

Desc_518.en: The Abiding Stillness Bracelet is unadorned, but when worn, the spiritual Qi seeps into the mind, helping one to eliminate distracting thoughts, practice the way of movement and stillness, and comprehend the relationship between reality and emptiness. "Ascend to the ultimate void and keep the tranquility of the mind."
Desc_518.cn: 守静环通体无饰，佩戴后却有灵气化入人心，助人摒除杂念，“致虚极，守静笃”，如复归混沌初开、有无未分之际，修动静之道，察虚实之理。

Desc_519.en: It is said that Ziyang Zhen Avatar not only made the Perception Chapter, but also passed on the Enlightened Truth Bracelet, which is made of spiritual jade that restores one to their original form and frees their body and mind. If one studies the scriptures regularly and diligently, they will comprehend the Way of the Truth and attain immortality.
Desc_519.cn: 世说紫阳真人既作悟真篇，又传悟真环，此环以灵玉制成，能助人归根复命，身心自在，倘若结合经书，勤加修习，便可了悟真道，羽化登仙。

Desc_520.en: The twelve shiny lines on the Defilement Purge Bracelet flow with the breath of the wearer, like running water that cleanses dirt, channels Qi, and nourishes the form. Wearing the bracelet for a long time not only stops one from aging but also restores their physical abilities, just like an Immortal.
Desc_520.cn: 净垢环至清至灵，其上十二道光华随人之呼吸而流动，如源头活水，涤荡污垢，有吐故纳新、导气养形之效，久佩之可令人齿发不衰，耳目益明，恍然如入神人之境。

Desc_521.en: There is no fixed form of the Ethereal Void Bracelet. When you look at it, you will only see a blurred fog, but after wearing it, you will enter a realm in which you can leave your body behind and flow between the heavens and earth unrestrained, reaching anywhere in this world as desired.
Desc_521.cn: 视之不见曰夷，听之不闻曰希。希夷环无形无色，望之如堕五里雾中，佩者却可生出坐忘之心，恍入离形去知、旷然合于天地之境，故而无所不通，无所不至。
